title: Shared ledger definitions
description: Ids, text, limits, enums and the server's stamp, shared by every event schema. Lengths count code points. The hand validator (packages/format/src/ledger-shape.ts) gives the same verdict.

nodeNumber.description: A card: its number on the board (from 1, in draw order, never reused); on a ledger line, its ledger number, unique in the project.

nodeNumbers.description: Two or more distinct node numbers, each once.

cards.description: The cards a retire took off the board, by ledger number, each once.

key.description: Retry key, per agent across the project.

mode.description: How a container lays out its cards: `grid`, `flow` (follows the links), `lanes`, `radial`, `column` (top to bottom in card order) or `row` (left to right in card order).

lineMode.description: A mode as a ledger line may name it: `list` on lines from ledger v11 and older only, read as `column`.

notList.description: `list` is now `column` (top to bottom in card order); `row` runs left to right, `flow` follows the links.

widths.description: How wide a container's cards are: `match`, every card in a column as wide as the column's widest card, or `own`, each card its own width. Left out, the container's mode decides: `match` for `grid` and `column`, `own` for `flow`, `row`, `lanes` and `radial`.

noteKind.description: What a person's note asks for: a comment, or more context

appWidth.description: An app panel's width in px.

appHeight.description: An app panel's height in px.

appHash.description: The SHA-256 of an app's code (its manifest, then its tools file), in lowercase hex, as list_apps gives it.

appRef.description: Which app an app card shows, and the size of its panel. Left out, the size is the manifest's `size`, else the default (docs/specification/apps.md § Panel size).

id.description: The app's folder name in the open ledger's `apps/`.

w.description: The panel's width in px; the card adds its padding.

nodeRef.description: A card: its number on this board, or `{ key }` of the item that drew it.

key.description: The key of the item that drew it.

stamp.description: What the server writes on every stored line. A sent body never sets these. On v2 `agent` is any name; from v3 an agent id.

v.description: The ledger format version of the line: 2 to 19.

seq.description: The line's position in the ledger.

at.description: When the server wrote the line.

agent.description: The agent that wrote the line: an agent id from v3, any name on v2.

person.description: The person's name, written only once a board has more than one person.

stampAgent.description: From v3 `agent` is an agent id.
stampAgent.$comment: Kept apart from `stamp` because ajv only credits the fields of a referenced schema whose own `if` is dynamic when that schema passes, so one bad agent would make every stamp field read as unknown; `stamp` stays static and always vouches for them.
